en: Hello! Welcome to our Customer Service. How can I assist you today?
Hi there! I'm your AI Assistant. What can I do for you?
id: Halo! Selamat datang di Layanan Pelanggan kami. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?
Hai! Saya Asisten AI Anda. Apa yang bisa saya lakukan untuk Anda?

en: Thank you for contacting us. See you soon!
id: Terima kasih telah menghubungi kami. Sampai jumpa!

en: Our customer support is available 24/7 via this chat. Our physical offices are open Mon-Fri, 9 AM - 5 PM.
id: Layanan pelanggan kami tersedia 24/7 via chat ini. Kantor fisik kami buka Senin-Jumat, 09.00 - 17.00.

en: Our headquarters is located at 123 Tech Street, Silicon Valley, CA. You can find us on Google Maps.
id: Kantor pusat kami berlokasi di Jl. Teknologi No. 123, Jakarta Selatan. Anda bisa menemukannya di Google Maps.

en: I can help with that. Please provide your Order ID (e.g., ORD-12345).
id: Saya bisa bantu. Mohon berikan Order ID Anda (contoh: ORD-12345).

en: I'm very sorry to hear that. Could you please describe the issue in more detail or provide the product name?
id: Maaf sekali mendengarnya. Bisakah Anda jelaskan masalahnya lebih detail atau sebutkan nama produknya?

en: I understand you're facing payment issues. Are you trying to pay via Credit Card, PayPal, or Bank Transfer?
id: Saya mengerti kendala Anda. Apakah Anda mencoba membayar via Kartu Kredit, E-Wallet, atau Transfer Bank?

en: For technical issues, have you tried clearing your cache or resetting your password?
id: Untuk masalah teknis, sudahkah Anda mencoba clear cache atau reset password Anda?

en: I want to talk to a human
I understand. I am connecting you to a human agent now. Please hold on a moment...
id: Baik, saya sambungkan Anda dengan agen Customer Service kami. Mohon tunggu sebentar...

en: Refunds can be processed within 30 days of purchase. Would you like to proceed with a refund request?
id: Refund bisa diproses dalam 30 hari pembelian. Apakah Anda ingin melanjutkan proses pengajuan refund?
